ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white pigmentation base with significant black mottling and focal spots concentrated along the trailing edge and lower peduncle region; distinct dark irregular banding near the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow angular vertex of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; trailing edge contains multiple sharp peaks and irregular valley indentations, specifically a deep notch on the right lobe's medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips directed upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular high-contrast white clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the entirety of both lobes, particularly dense on the outer margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across the central and medial lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged serrations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive saw-tooth pattern on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe characterized by deep, non-uniform pixel-depth excavations.
